meta.title: Typing @ in Gmail does not break the consultation
gaps: Connect the company's approval mailbox and configure the two-step email approval workflow with Asha and Bikram.
Open the approval email in Gmail and click Consult to create the Action:Consult reply.
Type @ in Gmail, select Chetan from the mention suggestions, and send the consultation.
Verify that exactly one consultation is created for Chetan and that any mentioned-you email does not create a duplicate consultation or bounce.
